nom: Amazon Basics Original Clean Astringent Skin Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one whose oily forehead this helped mattify, report it controls shine and busts oil effectively.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry combination skin says the alcohol content is too heavy for super dry skin and cautions against it, while another reviewer, who doesn't specify dry skin, reports it doesn't dry out her face at all.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with dry combination skin reports mixed results: it helped mattify her oily forehead but burned her cheeks and didn't work well for her overall.
segments.sensitive: The one reviewer who describes her skin as sensitive reports the astringent burned her cheeks a bit and didn't work out for her skin overall.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal/regular reports it works well for her and isn't too oily.

concerns.dehydration: One reviewer cautions that the alcohol content is too heavy for super dry skin, while another reviewer reports it doesn't dry her face out at all even with twice-daily use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports it burned her cheeks a bit; a more severe case describes breaking out in pimples and hives badly enough to require a hospital visit, though she doesn't specify having sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who've used astringents for blemishes for years, report it keeps their skin clean and clear of acne; one reviewer, however, reports a severe breakout reaction after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently report the astringent controls oil and shine effectively, including one whose oily forehead it helped mattify and another who calls it 'oil-busting.'

aspects.libelle: Bottle frequently leaks or arrives short

extraits.titre: Made me break out and I'm in alot of pain
extraits.texte: This astringent made me break out in pimples and hives so bad I had to go to hospital. Never in my life have I had anything like this. I am not allergic to anything, healthy as a horse, and have always used astringent during the day at work after lunch when I brush my teeth and refresh my face. I work 10-16 hrs a day seven days a week. I have always loved Amazon brand but this is crappy one Honestly I just don't understand how I got an infection from it and how it messed up so bad

extraits.titre: Bottle was leaky! Good for the price.
extraits.texte: I use toners every single night after washing and before moisturizing for the night. This one has a very strong medicinal smell. It also is very heavy on the alcohol for those with super dry skin, this isn't for you. I have sensitive skin so this burned my cheeks a bit. It did help mattify my oily forehead. I have dry combination skin, so this didn't work out for me 100% but if you have super oily skin, I feel you will like this. It does feel refreshing. I had problems with the bottle. It wouldn't close all the way, so it was leaky. I store it in a cabinet, so it wasn't much of a problem.

extraits.titre: One of the best values I found
extraits.texte: This was one of the best values I came across, this is just the basic astringent which is what I needed so the price & quality meets my needs. Sadly, the product spilled during delivery/transportation and about 3-4 oz were missing. I really wish Amazon would seal their products to avoid spillage, as proof of new product & lack of contamination. Aside from that, I decided to keep the product and make good use of it, it does clean skin pretty well. The scent is a bit on the strong side but no complaints on my end as I’m used to it since I’ve been using astringent since my teens & works for me to keep my skin clean & clear from acne.

extraits.titre: Just as good as the expensive brands...
extraits.texte: I’ve tried plenty of astringents ranging from very expensive to fairly cheap. My go to brand usually ran me about 10$ per bottle. I tend to use astringents for blemishes and it makes me face feel clean before bed. This is great. I was expecting the formula to seem weaker but it wasn’t. Cleaned just as well as other brands. The smell isn’t too strong (alcohol smell). Overall, when I run out of this I will be buying a new bottle because I like the way my face feels after I use it.

extraits.titre: So refreshing!! Great for my normal skin
extraits.texte: Its smells so good. I love eucalyptus fragrance. It is not too oily perfect for my skin. I have a regular skin, so it works for me. The only think probably is little hard is the alcohol, because it little strong for my eyes, so I need to close them when I apply it. But it feel so refreshing so I dont care about the alcohol because I know it helps to make the skin aseptic, microbe free!
I will forever buy this astringent! Great price, smells good and keeps my face blemish free! I use it every morning and night and doesn't dry out my face at all. Good stuff, highly recommend!
This product is a great value for the money, made of great quality and it works great at helping to tighten pores and reduce oiliness. I highly recommend this product!
